findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Paper towels were not observed at the restroom handwashing sink. CORRECTED - The person-in-charge was informed and paper towels were provided. Ensure paper towels are available at the restroom handwashing sink at all times for proper hand drying and to turn off the faucet to prevent recontamination of clean hands.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. [PF]

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure.
findings.comment: The restroom handwashing sink was observed to have no hot water available. The person-in-charge was informed during the routine inspection on February 12, 2026 and the inspector followed up with the facility on February 23, 2026 and March 9, 2026 to verify compliance, however there is still no hot water available. Ensure hot water is provided at the restroom handwashing sink at all times. The inspector will follow up again on March 19, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 5-103.11(B) Capacity. (B) Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. [PF]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT - Ambient thermometer was not observed in the walk-in cooler. The person-in-charge (PIC) was instructed to provide an ambient thermometer. Ensure an ambient thermometer is available in the warmest part of the cooler by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: The interior white coating of the microwave was observed to be peeling, exposing the underlying material. The PIC was informed. Ensure the microwave is repaired or replaced so that all surfaces are smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 4-101.19 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The surface area around the soda machine nozzles was observed to have soil accumulation. The PIC was informed and instructed to clean the area. Ensure the surface area around the soda nozzles is maintained clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(B) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The ceiling tile above the mop sink in the dry storage area was observed to be missing. The PIC was informed. Ensure the missing ceiling tile is replaced before next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.16(A) Wall and Ceiling Coverings and Coatings. (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The ceiling tiles above the three-compartment sink and mop sink at the dry storage area were observed to be soiled. The PIC was informed. Ensure the ceiling tiles are replaced before next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Dirty water and the mop head were observed in the mop bucket next to the mop sink. CORRECTED - The PIC was informed; the dirty water was discarded, and the mop head was placed in the wringer basket. Ensure water from mopping is discarded immediately after use and mop heads are properly stored by placing them in the wringer basket or hanging them to air-dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. [C]
